---
title: "IOTC Statistical Data Reporting: Form 3CE"
---
  
## Description
  
This form provides for the reporting of estimates of geo-referenced species-specific catches and efforts by fishing fleet, fishery, and space and time strata.

Click [here](./Form-3CE.xlsx) to download a blank version of Form 3CE, or [return](./index.html) to the list of all new versions of the IOTC statistical data reporting forms. The form allows reporting updated data for multiple fisheries simultaneously.

## Data Content

Total number and/or live weight of retained catches by species and effort by stratum, along with information on the value (%) and type of sampling coverage used for the estimations by month, year, fleet, fishery, raising status, and fishing area.

## Stratification

### General Information

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
| :--------| :----: | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------ |
| Reporting year | M | Gregorian calendar year of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | 4-digit integer | `1996` |
| Reporting entity | M | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the entity reporting the dataset to the IOTC Secretariat | **Code** from [Entities](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#entities) | `EUR` | 
| Flag state | M | Country in which a fishery vessel is registered and whose flag it is entitled to fly | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `FRA` |

| Catch unit | M | Units used to report the level of catches of a given species | **Code** from [Catch units](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#catchUnits) | `T` |

## Reporting Deadlines

-   **Longline fisheries**: 30 June (preliminary), 30 December (final)
-   **Surface fisheries**: 30 June (final)
-   **Coastal fisheries**: 30 June (final)

## Additional Information

### Effort Units Recommended By Gear Group

Estimates of fishing effort shall be expressed in units consistent with the recording requirements established by relevant IOTC Conservation and Management Measures and shall be complemented by the number of [fishing operations/sets](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/guidelines/stats/index.html#fishingOperation) for [longline fisheries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/guidelines/stats/index.html/#iotcLonglineFishery) and [surface fisheries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/guidelines/stats/index.html#iotcSurfaceFishery).

For most gears (purse seine, longline, gillnet, handline), a fishing operation corresponds to one complete deployment and retrieval of the gear. In [pole-and-line fisheries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/guidelines/stats/index.html#poleAndLineFishery), multiple poles may be operated simultaneously while fishing on the same school. In such cases, the overall fishing activity may constitute a fishing event that includes several individual fishing operations/sets. However, for reporting purposes, effort should be standardised in a manner that ensures comparability across fisheries and consistency with observer coverage requirements.

For coastal fisheries, it is recommended that effort data be submitted using the same effort units as those prescribed for longline and surface fisheries characterised by the same fishing gear.

### Standard Effort Units by Gear Group

| Gear group | Primary effort | Secondary effort | 
| :------------ | :-------------------- | :------------------- |
Gillnets (GI)        | Number of fishing days   | Number of fishing operations/sets |
Hooks and lines (HL) | Number of fishing days   | Number of fishing operations/sets |
Longlines (LL)       | Number of hooks deployed | Number of fishing operations/sets |
Other gears (OT)     | Number of days at sea    | Number of active gears or fishing operations/sets |
Pole-and-lines (PL)  | Number of fishing days   | Number of fishing operations/sets |
Purse seines (PS)    | Number of fishing hours  | Number of fishing operations/sets |

### Additional Effort Indicators

Additional units may be considered to refine and standardise the estimation of nominal fishing effort:

i. In gillnet fisheries, the surface area of the nets deployed may better reflect effort intensity by accounting for differences in net length and height;

ii. In hooks and line fisheries, the number of hooks may be used as required for longline fisheries;

iii. In longline fisheries that use trap line loops as terminal gear devices (lazos in Spanish), the ratio between the number of hooks and loop lines may provide a simple and efficient metric for reporting effort. In such cases, species-specific catch data should be reported for both hook-based and loop-based effort units;

iv. In purse seine fisheries, the numbers of successful and null fishing operations, searching time, and surface area explored may complement the information provided by fishing time and the total number of fishing sets. 

### Units Not Recommended

From a general perspective, the use of trips as a unit of effort is not recommended, as trip duration may vary widely due to vessel size, fishing success, environmental conditions, or operational constraints (fuel availability).

Similarly, fishing events may not accurately reflect the level of effort exerted in pole-and-line fisheries where the number of poles operated simultaneously varies between events. For this reason, the fishing operation/set remains the preferred standardised unit for effort reporting wherever feasible.

### Other Dimensions

The spatial and temporal resolutions, catch units, and level of extrapolation vary according to the fishery category.

| Category | Temporal resolution | Spatial resolution | Catch unit | Extrapolation | 
| :-------- | :--------- | :---------- | :------------- | :-------: |
[Surface fisheries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/guidelines/stats/index.html#iotcSurfaceFishery) | Month | [1° grid area](https://data.iotc.org/reference/1.0.0/domain/admin/index.html#IOgrids1x1) | Live weight equivalent | M |
[Longline fisheries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/guidelines/stats/index.html#iotcLonglineFishery) | Month or finer for the SC | [5° grid area](https://data.iotc.org/reference/1.0.0/domain/admin/stats/index.html#IOgrids5x5) or finer for the SC | Numbers or live weight equivalent | M |
[Coastal fisheries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/guidelines/stats/index.html#iotcCoastalFishery) | Year or finer | [Irregular areas](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#IOTCareasAR) | Numbers or live weight equivalent | O |
